evidence.detail: rs/d/n stores an overlay type, a referenced icon/item id, and x/y offsets in a static registry keyed by the base item id.
Its sprite resolver selects either the client text-icon sprite table for TEXT_ICON or R28 ItemDefinition item-sprite generation for ITEM_ICON.
The item-definition update parser recognizes exact icon/iconitem/iconoffsets/iconx/icony configuration keys and constructs rs/d/n descriptors for the corresponding item ids.
The item/interface rendering path tests the registry for the current item id and draws the resolved overlay sprite at the item's screen coordinates plus the descriptor offsets.

candidates.note: ItemIconOverlay is the conservative semantic name for this per-item sprite-overlay descriptor; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/d/n$a is an enum with surviving exact constants TEXT_ICON and ITEM_ICON.
ItemIconOverlay switches on this enum to distinguish sprites sourced from the text-icon sprite table from sprites generated from another item definition.
The item-definition update path creates TEXT_ICON overlays from the icon configuration and ITEM_ICON overlays from iconitem, sharing the same configured x/y offsets.

candidates.note: ItemIconOverlayType is the conservative semantic name for this exact two-mode item overlay source enum; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
